newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy May 21-22 diesel, gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy May 21-22 diesel, gasoline.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 230,000 barrels of gas oil and 40,000 barrels of 95-octane leaded gasoline for May 21-22 delivery, a CPC source said on Friday.
The tender seeks 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil. The combination cargo is for delivery to Colombo on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on April 29 and offers will be valid until May 1.
A CPC source said Sri Lanka required a bigger volume of diesel than its usual 220,000 barrels to meet demand for electricity due to lower hydropower generation during the current drought.
But CPC has no requirements for jet fuel at this time.

Sri Lanka has recently awarded its tender to buy 85,000 barrels of gas oil and 60,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene to Swiss trader Glencore at 10 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for May 10-12 delivery, c-and-f Trincomalee.
